name: unsafe fn split_at_mut (self , mid : usize) -> (* mut [T] , * mut [T])
rule: `mid` must be in-bounds of the underlying allocated object: `self` must be dereferenceable and span a single allocation at least `mid * size_of::<T>()` bytes long. These requirements apply even if the resulting pointers are never used.
api: impl < T > * mut [T] { unsafe fn split_at_mut (self , mid : usize) -> (* mut [T] , * mut [T]) }
